user.title: Evolute
user.description: Enter the access_token and refresh_token cookie values from your browser after logging in at app.evassist.ru (DevTools → Application → Cookies → evy-platform-access / evy-platform-refresh).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Evolute
reauth_confirm.description: Evolute rejected the account credentials after an attempt to refresh them. Log in to app.evassist.ru in your browser and paste the new evy-platform-access / evy-platform-refresh cookie values.

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate with the provided tokens
error.cannot_connect: Evolute is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Evolute returned an invalid response. Try again later.
error.cannot_access: Evolute denied or could not complete the account request.
error.account_id_missing: The verified Evolute access token does not contain an account ID.
error.account_unverified: The account for this existing Evolute entry could not be verified. Its tokens were not changed.
error.account_mismatch: These tokens belong to a different Evolute account. Sign in to the account used by this entry.
